battle.name: 第二次希土戰爭
battle.brief: 本列表所列第二次希土戰爭始於1919年5月，以希臘軍隊在伊茲密爾登陸為起點，戰事隨其向安納托利亞西部推進而擴大。俄製別丹步槍（Berdan rifle）於1866年列裝，曾為俄國陸軍制式步槍，並在相關地面戰事中配備於步兵部隊。

kit.name: 別丹步槍
kit.history: 別丹步槍在1870年代成為俄國陸軍步兵的制式槍械，主要由步兵連配發；莫辛—納甘特步槍服役後，它仍留在後備與戰時補充體系，並見於蘇聯早期地面部隊。

countries: 這場戰爭的主要交戰方是希臘王國與土耳其民族運動；1919年的土耳其仍由奧斯曼帝國政府統治，共和國直到1923年10月才成立，因此不能把後者預先寫成土耳其共和國。奧斯曼政府受列強制約，無力有效控制安納托利亞西部；伊茲密爾最初由英、法、意軍占領，希臘軍隊其後進駐。希臘把占領區當作向小亞細亞及色雷斯推進的基地，民族運動則把任何希臘常駐與行政安排視為對安納托利亞主權的侵犯。主戰場由伊茲密爾經艾登、庫塔希亞、埃斯基謝希爾延伸到薩卡里亞河，另一條戰線在色雷斯的亞得里亞堡。海上運輸與港口供應明顯偏向希軍，民族運動依靠薩瓦斯及安納托利亞內陸的道路、兵站，這種地理差異貫穿全程。
countriesEn: The principal belligerents in this war were the Kingdom of Greece and the Turkish National Movement; Turkey in 1919 was still governed by the Ottoman government, and the republic was not proclaimed until October 1923, so the latter cannot be projected backward as the Republic of Turkey. The Ottoman government was constrained by the Allied powers and unable to control western Anatolia effectively; Smyrna was initially occupied by British, French and Italian troops, and Greek forces entered afterward. Greece treated the occupied zone as a base for advance into Asia Minor and Thrace, while the National Movement regarded any permanent Greek military presence or administrative arrangement as an infringement on Anatolian sovereignty. The main theater ran from Smyrna through Aydın, Kütahya and Eskişehir to the Sakarya River, while another front lay around Adrianople in Thrace. Sea transport and port supply clearly favored the Greek army, whereas the National Movement depended on roads and depots through Sivas and the Anatolian interior; this geographical imbalance shaped the entire campaign.
people: 希臘方面的總理埃萊夫特里奧斯·維尼澤洛斯決定了向安納托利亞擴張的政策；尼古拉奧斯·波利蒂斯出任伊茲密爾高級專員，處理行政命令與軍隊擴張之間的摩擦。康斯坦丁諾斯·達伊奧斯率領第五師進入伊茲密爾，後來指揮安納托利亞戰區的一個軍；斯蒂利亞諾斯·戈納塔斯先統率第七師，亦曾擔任軍級指揮官。穆斯塔法·凱末爾於1919年5月19日抵達薩姆松，逐步成為民族運動武裝的組織者與統帥；阿里·富阿德·傑貝索伊在薩瓦斯整編民族軍並任早期司令，雷費特·貝萊參與中部戰線的指揮安排，伊斯梅特·伊諾尼則在後來指揮西部戰線及伊諾尼戰役。尤呂克·阿里·埃費率領巴爾克埃西爾一帶的地方武裝，謝里夫·巴伊拉克達爾在艾登地區組織武裝。各人的實際權力隨戰局變動，因此政治指揮、軍區指揮與地方武裝之間並非一條從未中斷的單一權力鏈。
peopleEn: On the Greek side, Prime Minister Eleftherios Venizelos determined the policy of expansion into Anatolia; Nikolaos Politis served as high commissioner for Smyrna and handled friction between administrative instructions and military expansion. Konstantinos Daios led the 5th Division into Smyrna and later commanded a corps in the Asia Minor theater, while Stylianos Gonatas commanded the 7th Division and later held corps-level commands. Mustafa Kemal arrived at Samsun on 19 May 1919 and gradually became the organizer and commander of the National Movement’s armed forces; Ali Fuat Cebesoy organized the National Army at Sivas and served as its early commander, Refet Bele took part in command arrangements on the central front, and İsmet İnönü later directed the western front and fought at İnönü. Yörük Ali Efe led armed groups around Balıkesir, while Şerif Bayrakdar organized forces around Aydın. Their real authority changed with each phase of the campaign, so political command, theater command and local armed groups did not form a single uninterrupted chain of authority.
kits: 可確認在交戰雙方使用過的武器包括：希軍步兵主要使用奧製曼利徹M1895步槍，機砲與步兵砲有Hotchkiss Mle 1914機槍及37毫米步兵砲，師屬 artillery 則有施耐德－克勒索75毫米Mle 1915野戰砲和155毫米Mle 1917榴彈砲；部分海軍與守備單位仍配法製勒貝爾M1886步槍。民族運動方面使用奧斯曼軍械、地方武裝原有武器及戰利品，因此可見毛瑟M1889或M1890步槍、溫徹斯特M1895或M1907步槍、Schwarzlose M07/12機槍，以及7.5厘米Schwarzlose M1908野戰砲和山砲。這些型號並非每個師都配齊，同一戰線上也會出現不同來源武器。步槍彈藥包括曼利徹的8×57毫米R、勒貝爾的8×32毫米R、毛瑟的7.92×57毫米及溫徹斯特的.30-06，混發或混收會直接造成無法使用的後果；75、105與155毫米砲彈也不能互換。伊茲密爾－卡薩巴鐵路是千毫米窄軌，主要承擔艾登方向運輸；道路車隊、馬匹和沿海航運則補足鐵路，鐵路遭破壞時，前線的砲彈、糧食與燃料供應便會迅速收緊。
kitsEn: Confirmed weapons used by the opposing forces included the Austrian Mannlicher M1895 rifle as the main infantry arm of the Greek army, the Hotchkiss Mle 1914 machine gun and 37 mm infantry gun, and the Schneider-Creusot 75 mm Mle 1915 field gun and 155 mm Mle 1917 howitzer in divisional artillery; some naval and garrison units retained French Lebel Model 1886 rifles. Nationalist units used Ottoman stores, weapons belonging to local bands and captured matériel, so Mauser Model 1889 or 1890 rifles, Winchester Model 1895 or 1907 rifles, Schwarzlose M07/12 machine guns, and the 7.5 cm Schwarzlose M1908 field and mountain guns could all appear. These types were not fully equipped in every division, and weapons from different sources could meet on the same front. Rifle ammunition included 8×57 mmR for the Mannlicher, 8×32 mmR for the Lebel, 7.92×57 mm for the Mauser and .30-06 for the Winchester; mixed issue or collection created ammunition that could not be used. Artillery ammunition for 75, 105 and 155 mm guns likewise could not be interchanged. The Smyrna–Cassaba Railway was a 1,000 mm narrow-gauge line carrying most traffic toward Aydın; road vehicles, horse teams and coastal shipping supplemented it, and whenever the railway was damaged, the front quickly lost access to shells, food and fuel.
tactics: 1919年的希軍以師級步兵、機砲營和師屬砲兵沿伊茲密爾－艾登鐵路及平行道路推進，典型攻勢是先用砲兵壓制，再由步兵分批躍進，奪取道路交叉點後建立新供應線；前線拉長後，希軍不得不把行軍、警戒與運輸同時進行。民族運動的早期武裝則採小隊行動，利用地形夜間移動，襲擊孤立哨所、偵察隊與鐵路通信，並避免在補給不足時接受希軍選擇決戰。1920年民族軍完成制度化後， tactics 轉為有步兵核心、炮兵、補充兵站與指揮部的計畫性攻勢。居姆盧普納爾戰役利用希軍前伸後暴露的側翼與後方；埃斯基謝希爾、庫塔希亞作戰則以集中兵力逐段奪取交通中心。薩卡里亞會戰中，希軍利用既設正面、縱深陣地和預備隊進行炮兵支援與反擊，民族軍則連續投入縱隊衝擊；盛夏的乾熱、飲水不足與道路負荷使任何一方的持續攻勢都受到限制。
tacticsEn: In 1919 the Greek army advanced along the Smyrna–Aydın railway and parallel roads with divisional infantry, machine-gun battalions and divisional artillery. A typical attack began with artillery suppression, followed by infantry advancing in bounded groups to seize road junctions and establish a new supply line; once the front stretched, marching, guarding and transport had to proceed simultaneously. Early Nationalist bands used small formations, moved by night, attacked isolated posts, reconnaissance parties and railway communications, and avoided accepting a decisive battle chosen by the Greeks while their supply remained insufficient. After the National Army was regularized in 1920, its tactics shifted toward planned offensive operations built around an infantry core, artillery, replacement depots and a field headquarters. At Dumlupınar the Nationalists exploited the exposed flank and rear created by the overextended Greek advance; the operations for Eskişehir and Kütahya concentrated force to seize transport centers one after another. At Sakarya the Greeks used prepared fronts, depth positions and reserves for artillery-supported counterattacks, while the National Army committed columns in successive attacks. The dry summer heat, inadequate water and limited road capacity constrained the endurance of either side’s offensive.
data: 1919年5月15日，達伊奧斯的第五師進入伊茲密爾，先控制港口及伊茲密爾－卡薩巴鐵路車站，使希軍能向內陸輸送部隊與糧秣。5月19日，凱末爾抵達薩姆松，開始建立能連續指揮的軍事組織；五月下旬，希軍在馬爾加奇與克孜勒曲庫一線和地方武裝接觸。6月27日，希軍占領艾登，隨後以鐵路和道路維持艾登方向的補給。9月12日，希軍進入貝爾加馬，9月20日占領柯爾卡奇，9月27日推進至索馬；埃費在巴爾克埃西爾與索馬一帶的地方武裝不斷襲擊希軍警戒線，使前線難以完全平靜。10月14日，希軍另一支部隊進駐亞得里亞堡，色雷斯方向由此打通。與此同時，民族運動在七月下旬至八月初召開埃爾祖魯姆大會，九月四日至六日召開薩瓦斯大會，決定建立民族軍，但有規編制的民族軍到1920年才真正投入戰場。
dataEn: On 15 May 1919, Daios’s 5th Division entered Smyrna and first secured the port and the Smyrna–Cassaba railway station, allowing the Greek army to move troops and supplies inland. Mustafa Kemal arrived at Samsun on 19 May and began building an organization capable of continuous command; in late May, Greek troops came into contact with local armed groups around Malgaç and Kızılçullu. On 27 June the Greeks occupied Aydın and thereafter used the railway and roads to sustain supply in that direction. On 12 September Greek forces entered Bergama, on 20 September they occupied Kırkağaç, and on 27 September they advanced to Soma. Armed groups under Efe around Balıkesir and Soma repeatedly struck the Greek警戒 line, making it impossible for the front to become completely quiet. On 14 October another Greek force entered Adrianople, opening the Thracian front. Meanwhile, the National Movement held the Erzurum Congress from late July to early August and the Sivas Congress from 4 to 6 September, deciding to establish a National Army, although a regularly organized National Army did not enter the field until 1920.
cause: 希臘遠征並非單純的港口防衛。維尼澤洛斯內閣把占領伊茲密爾與向龐特斯及安納托利亞內陸擴張相連，軍事指揮層則希望控制艾登－庫塔希亞交通線並鞏固色雷斯方向；民族運動的反制也超出地方衝突，因為薩瓦斯大會要求建立全國性軍隊，並把安納托利亞主權遭到持續分割列為動員理由。1920年4月20日，大國民議會以法律建立民族軍，凱末爾於6月接掌指揮。希軍起初憑較完整的師制、砲兵與一戰經驗占優，6月17日占領庫塔希亞，7月23日進入埃斯基謝希爾；但前線越過鐵路與主要道路，後方補給和側翼保護便開始失衡。民族軍於8月26日在居姆盧普納爾打擊希軍側翼與後方，使希軍攻勢中止；9月19日奪回埃斯基謝希爾，10月3日收復蓋迪茲，10月17日再奪庫塔希亞。希軍退守薩卡里亞一線後，戰役由希軍的連續推進轉為雙方爭奪既有交通與陣地的消耗戰。
causeEn: The Greek expedition was not merely the defense of a port. The Venizelos government connected the occupation of Smyrna with expansion toward Pontus and the Anatolian interior, while the military command sought to control the Aydın–Kütahya transport line and consolidate the Thracian direction; Nationalist resistance likewise exceeded a local disturbance, because the Sivas Congress called for a national army and treated the continuing partition of Anatolian sovereignty as grounds for mobilization. On 20 April 1920 the Grand National Assembly established the National Army by law, and Mustafa Kemal assumed command in June. The Greeks initially had the advantage in divisional organization, artillery and First World War experience: they occupied Kütahya on 17 June and Eskişehir on 23 July. Once their front passed beyond the railway and principal roads, however, rear supply and flank protection became unbalanced. The National Army struck the Greek flank and rear at Dumlupınar on 26 August, halting the Greek advance; it retook Eskişehir on 19 September, recovered Gediz on 3 October and captured Kütahya again on 17 October. After the Greeks fell back to the Sakarya line, the campaign changed from continuous Greek advance into a struggle over established communications and positions.
impact: 希軍退入薩卡里亞防線後，民族軍仍保有攻勢，但希軍也沒有被消滅。1921年6月27日開始的第一場伊諾尼戰役中，希軍對土軍中央的攻勢受挫，民族軍得以把部分兵力留在伊諾尼方向。8月23日至9月5日的薩卡里亞會戰是全役最大規模的陣地戰：民族軍由多個方向連續進攻，希軍則依靠既設陣地、炮兵和預備隊維持薩卡里亞河西岸正面。9月6日至10日，希軍在科穆爾汗反擊，迫使民族軍分兵應對，卻未改變整體局勢。9月23日至10月13日的第二場伊諾尼戰役再次形成拉鋸，雙方都未摧毀對方主力。雙方在薩卡里亞與伊諾尼均有重大死傷，但現存師級紀錄、陣亡名冊及戰後官方統計不足以支持完整而一致的總數，因此不能列出可信的精確傷亡。戰局同時受到希臘政治危機影響；維尼澤洛斯政府在1920年11月選舉後已失去執政，遠征在兵力補充與政治支持上都接近極限。希軍遂尋求停戰，民族軍則仍控制安納托利亞中部與西部的戰略主動。
impactEn: After the Greeks withdrew into the Sakarya defenses, the National Army still retained the initiative, but the Greek army had not been destroyed. In the First Battle of İnönü, beginning on 27 June 1921, a Greek attack against the Turkish center was checked, allowing the National Army to retain troops in the İnönü sector. The Battle of Sakarya from 23 August to 5 September was the largest set-piece engagement of the campaign: the National Army attacked from several directions, while the Greeks used prepared positions, artillery and reserves to maintain a front along the west bank of the Sakarya. Between 6 and 10 September, the Greek counterattack at Kömürhan forced the National Army to divert troops, although it did not alter the overall situation. The Second Battle of İnönü, from 23 September to 13 October, produced another attritional contest in which neither side destroyed the opposing main force. Both sides suffered heavy losses at Sakarya and İnönü, but surviving divisional records, casualty lists and later official statistics do not support a complete and consistent aggregate, so no defensible precise casualty total can be given. Greek politics also weighed on the campaign; the Venizelos government had already lost office after the November 1920 election, and the expedition was nearing the limits of both manpower replacement and political support. The Greeks therefore sought an armistice, while the National Army still held the strategic initiative in central and western Anatolia.
result: 10月11日，雙方在穆丹亞簽署停戰協定，戰鬥至此停止。協定承認土耳其對伊茲密爾的主權，並要求希軍撤至薩卡里亞以西及馬摩拉海一側；停戰不是希軍全軍覆沒後的無條件投降，希軍仍保有成建制部隊並在協商下撤離。1923年7月24日簽署的洛桑條約正式終止戰爭狀態，確認希臘放棄對伊茲密爾與亞得里亞堡的主權要求，土耳其取得安納托利亞西部與中部的大部，希臘則保住色雷斯西部的有限區域。戰役的直接結果是希臘的安納托利亞遠征失敗，民族運動則由一支在內陸形成的力量轉為能接管新地區的常備軍，成為安卡拉政府的軍事基礎。戰區曾出現的野戰鐵路、分散砲兵、不同口徑彈藥與漫長補給線，後來都反映在土耳其軍隊的編制與後勤改革中；真正劃定邊界的文件則是穆丹亞停戰與洛桑條約，而不是任何一場戰役的單獨勝負。
resultEn: On 11 October, the two sides signed the Armistice of Mudanya and the fighting ceased. The agreement recognized Turkish sovereignty over Smyrna and required Greek troops to withdraw west of the Sakarya and toward the Sea of Marmara. It was not an unconditional surrender following the annihilation of the Greek army: Greek formations remained intact and withdrew under negotiated terms. The Treaty of Lausanne, signed on 24 July 1923, formally ended the state of war, confirmed Greece’s abandonment of its claims to Smyrna and Adrianople, and left Turkey with most of western and central Anatolia while Greece retained a limited area of western Thrace. The immediate result was the failure of the Greek expedition into Anatolia and the transformation of the National Movement from an inland force into a regular army capable of assuming control of newly secured regions, providing the armed basis of the Ankara government. The wartime use of field railways, dispersed artillery, incompatible ammunition calibers and lengthy supply routes later influenced both Turkish force organization and logistics reform; the borders were fixed by the Mudanya Armistice and the Treaty of Lausanne, not by the outcome of any single battle.
